llm.summary: This paid skill clearly discloses its order and payment flow and its sensitive behavior is limited to the stated service purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses outbound HTTPS and reads a local payment credential from a scoped order file; this is sensitive but disclosed in SKILL.md and proportionate to a paid service workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact declares required capabilities and a dependency on clawtip-skill; there are executable helper scripts but no install-time persistence, package installation, or background worker setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are specific: create an order, process payment through clawtip, then verify the order. I found no hidden role changes, prompt injection, unrelated automation, or broad content collection instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It writes order metadata under ~/.openclaw/skills/orders/{indicator}/{order_no}.json and later reads the same scoped file. Path validation limits traversal, and no broad filesystem indexing or unrelated credential access was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides a paid software copyright registration readiness review, and the network order creation, payment verification, and local order file handling match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that your question text and payment credential/order data are sent to api.ideaidea.com.cn over HTTPS, and order metadata is stored locally under the OpenClaw orders directory. Do not include source code, legal documents, trade secrets, or personal identity information in the question unless you are comfortable sending that text to the service provider.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: Verified: service.py reads payCredential from the local order file and sends it with slug and order_no to https://api.ideaidea.com.cn for payment verification. This is sensitive, but SKILL.md explicitly discloses the Phase 3 transmission and the behavior is aligned with the paid clawtip workflow.
